title: Matches and structured scores
description: Maintain match skeletons, participants, periods, scores, status and formal lineups.
terminalStatus: This is a terminal status and cannot be reopened through the normal workflow.
confirmArchive: Archive this match? Matches with confirmed scores cannot be archived.

events.title: Formal events and VAR
events.help: Events follow the authoritative order. VAR must target an explicit event, and score changes require the complete resulting score snapshot.
events.rescindWarning: Rescinding preserves the audit history and publishes a new match revision; it does not physically delete the event.

messages.required: Enter an event type, status, authoritative order and a reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.varRequired: VAR requires an explicit reviewed event and outcome.
messages.reasonRequired: Enter a rescind reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.failed: Operation failed. Reload and check the revision, event references and score snapshot.

commentaries.title: Formal English commentary
commentaries.help: The supplier platform stores only formal English source text. Event links must be explicitly selected and are never inferred from time, players or goal flags.
commentaries.rescindWarning: Rescinding preserves the record and publishes a new match revision. It cannot be directly restored; create a new record to republish.

messages.required: Enter a commentary type, English text, display order and a reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.playersDifferent: Primary and related players must be different.
messages.reasonRequired: Enter a rescind reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.failed: Operation failed. Reload and check the match revision and references.

statistics.title: Formal match statistics
statistics.help: Statistics are submitted as a complete team or player snapshot. Blank metrics are omitted, and statistics never change scores, events or match status.
statistics.snapshotWarning: Saving completely replaces all formal statistics for the selected team or player; it is not a partial append.
statistics.deprecatedWarning: This scope contains deprecated metrics. Saving is blocked to prevent historical values from being removed until a migration policy is confirmed.
statistics.clearWarning: This scope already has formal statistics. Clearing is a high-risk empty snapshot operation that increments the match revision and retains an audit record.

messages.required: Select a statistics subject and enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.invalidJson: A JSON metric must contain a valid object or array.
messages.deprecatedBlocked: This scope contains deprecated metrics and cannot be fully replaced before a migration policy is confirmed.
messages.definitionsFailed: The statistics definition catalog could not be loaded, so complete snapshot submission is disabled.
messages.clearForbidden: Clearing existing formal statistics requires the dedicated statistics clear permission.
messages.saved: Formal statistics snapshot saved and published.
messages.failed: Operation failed. Reload and check the match revision, metric type, precision and scope.

messages.statusRequired: Select a target status and enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.statusFailed: Transition failed. Reload and check the transition rules, kickoff time and confirmed score.
messages.lineupRequired: Select a team and enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
messages.lineupFailed: Lineup save failed. Reload and check the revision, participating team and player conflicts.
